rules.text: No ego; problems in select careers; low self-confidence; introvert; can't express experiences openly

source.quote: Such people face a lot of problems in select careers.

rules.say: Missing 1 is linked with little ego, low self-confidence, an introverted nature and difficulty sharing your experiences openly. It can also bring problems in certain careers.

rules.text: Problems in love; lack of stability, patience; don't follow timetable; live in imagination; lack intuition and confidence

source.quote: Such people face problems in their love relations.

rules.say: Missing 2 is linked with problems in love, less stability and patience, and difficulty following a routine. You may live in imagination and lack intuition and confidence.

rules.text: Less grace of Guru/God; problems in promotion and growth; lack creative thinking and decisions; low confidence, distracted

source.quote: The grace of the Guru and lord is less

rules.say: Missing 3 is linked with less grace of Guru and God, problems in promotion and growth, and weaker creative thinking and decisions. You may feel low in confidence and distracted.

rules.text: Lack of financial stability and growth; lack of intuition; more struggle; directionless; weak thought power, forgetful

source.quote: Lack of financial stability and growth

rules.say: Missing 4 is linked with less financial stability and growth, more struggle and a lack of direction. Your intuition and thought power may be weaker, and you may be forgetful.

rules.text: Lack of stability, confidence; stomach and back pain; trouble starting work; business loss; problems building own house

source.quote: Health problems related to stomach and back pain.

rules.say: Missing 5 is linked with less stability and confidence, trouble starting work, business losses and problems building your own house. Take care of stomach and back pain.

rules.text: Lack of money and luxury; struggle; few good friends; family support late; love problems from introversion

source.quote: Lack of money and luxurious life.

rules.say: Missing 6 is linked with less money and luxury, more struggle and few good friends. Family support may come late, and being introverted can cause problems in love.

rules.text: Hindrance in work and studies; no family support; little success despite effort; mental disturbance

source.quote: The struggle is more and Success is less.

rules.say: Missing 7 is linked with hurdles in work and studies, little family support and mental disturbance. You may see less success for the effort you put in.

rules.text: Difficult financial decisions; no perfection in work; low motivation; ups and downs; poor health and wealth

source.quote: Such peoples find it difficult to make financial decisions

rules.say: Missing 8 is linked with difficulty in financial decisions, low motivation, ups and downs and less perfection in work. Take care of your health and wealth.

rules.text: Low energy and enthusiasm; ups and downs; weak will and action; lack of reputation/fame; doesn't care about others' feelings
rules.say: Missing 9 is linked with low energy and enthusiasm, weak willpower, ups and downs and less reputation. Take care to stay mindful of others' feelings.
